Have you ever wondered how the first tree on Earth evolved? In this video, we explore the fascinating story of how barren rock transformed into lush forests, from the mysterious giant Prototaxites to Wattieza, the first known tree on Earth. Discover how fungi, algae, soil, and the evolution of wood allowed the first plants to conquer the land and reshape life on Earth.
